method: Compared all original scenes with the actual clipped transparent edit layers.
Visually inspected every target in enlarged A/B crops and each scene at phone size.
Used CIE Lab D65 DeltaE76 and changed-pixel area only to identify candidates; object presence, count and shape were checked visually.
Candidate zoom targets were also inspected at actual scene widths 850 and 2550 CSS pixels.
Kept the six normal / four zoom allocation, every target center and puzzle ID unchanged. Expanded two existing target edges only to contain the complete acorn removal and leaf-vein tip.
Used AI image editing only on the nine ambiguous targets. Two are color-family changes; the other seven clarify removals or counts.
limitations: Pixel thresholds are screening evidence, not a timed usability result. Approximate image composites can differ from browser antialiasing at an edge pixel. Replacement crops are verified separately in the actual browser renderer.
